user.title: Connect to Solaire Intelligence
user.description: Create an integration key in the SI portal ({key_url}) and paste it here. The key decides which plants Home Assistant sees and whether it may control them — you can revoke it there at any time.

reauth_confirm.title: Solaire Intelligence key no longer valid
reauth_confirm.description: The integration key was revoked or the account behind it lost access. Create a new key in the SI portal ({key_url}) and paste it here.

error.not_a_key: That is not an SI integration key — it should start with si_ha_.
error.invalid_auth: That key was not accepted. It may have been revoked.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Solaire Intelligence. Check this Home Assistant's internet connection and try again.

abort.already_configured: This key is already set up.

init.title: Connection
init.description: Use WebSocket (port 9001) only if your network blocks outbound port 8883.
